policy: Optional features stay disabled until a written need, threat review, benchmark, cost estimate, and rollback test are approved.

features.problem_statement: Improve recall only if measured lexical/graph retrieval misses relevant evidence.
features.cost_estimate: Not estimated until corpus size, model, and hosting are selected.
features.benchmark: Compare Recall@k, nDCG@k, latency, storage and cost against lexical/graph baseline.
features.rollback: Disable flag, route to lexical/graph retrieval, remove vectors by tenant/version policy.
features.gate: Need retrieval baseline and tenant/deletion tests first

features.problem_statement: Expose evidence relationships when operators need graph inspection.
features.cost_estimate: UI/graph rendering cost not estimated; cap nodes and edges per view.
features.benchmark: Measure render latency and keyboard/screen-reader task completion at capped graph sizes.
features.rollback: Disable view; keep text and table alternatives available.
features.gate: Implement only when graph inspection is a demonstrated workflow

features.problem_statement: Fine-tune only when prompting/retrieval cannot meet a measured quality target.
features.cost_estimate: Requires selected model, compute, dataset size and budget; currently unknown.
features.benchmark: Licensed reviewed versioned dataset; isolated holdout; task metrics and cost/quality comparison.
features.rollback: Retain previous model/config snapshot and route back; never equate SQLite fact storage with weight training.
features.gate: Requires data licensing approval and compute budget

features.problem_statement: Serve approved content when connectivity is unreliable.
features.cost_estimate: Depends on topic pack sizes, license and update cadence.
features.benchmark: Checksum verification, incremental update bytes, cold lookup latency, deletion behavior.
features.rollback: Pin previous pack manifest or remove the pack and use online/limited mode.
features.gate: Need licensed dataset and device storage UX

features.problem_statement: Detect unexpected data-path access using isolated synthetic canary records.
features.cost_estimate: Low expected storage but alert operations cost unknown.
features.benchmark: Verify canaries are excluded from normal retrieval, learning and evaluation; test alert precision.
features.rollback: Disable detector and purge canary namespace without touching real user records.
features.gate: Only isolated, marked synthetic canaries; never poison normal data

features.problem_statement: Choose providers from measured quality, latency, cost, privacy and health signals.
features.cost_estimate: Requires measured provider prices and usage; unknown today.
features.benchmark: Shadow mode against stable route; evaluate quality, p95 latency, error rate, privacy constraints and cost.
features.rollback: Disable flag and pin known-good provider/config snapshot.
features.gate: Needs representative multi-provider telemetry; never infer from marketing labels/free quotas

features.problem_statement: Process images/audio/documents only where user workflows need them.
features.cost_estimate: Depends on modality, file sizes, provider and retention; unknown.
features.benchmark: Consent, MIME/magic validation, decompression limits, size limits, redaction, deletion and latency tests.
features.rollback: Disable modality endpoints and fall back to supported text path.
features.gate: Explicit consent, validation, privacy controls and limits required

features.problem_statement: Suggest bounded research tasks from unresolved questions and weak claims.
features.cost_estimate: Bound by explicit per-job request, byte and elapsed-time budgets; actual cost unknown.
features.benchmark: Allowlisted connectors, approval gates, adversarial prompt-injection suite, checkpoint/resume and budget enforcement.
features.rollback: Kill switch cancels new jobs and safely pauses active jobs at checkpoint.
features.gate: Planning may propose only; admin approval required before large runs; no shell or self-deploy access
